card.name: Start of produce/production words
card.fires_on: The opening piece "pro" or "rep" of a word that continues as produce, production, producer or reproduction, often in capitals. It fires before the rest of the word appears.

modes.label: Pro- before duce/duction
modes.description: The start of produce, production or producers, split after "Pro".

modes.label: Rep- before roduction
modes.description: The start of reproduction or reproductive, split after "Rep".

modes.label: Other pro- starts
modes.description: Other word openings with pro- that are not produce, such as procreative or progressed.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with produce, production or producing.
card.plain: It fires on the first chunk of words like produce, production and reproduction, before the word is finished.
